race.comment: MASOUN (1) ready to peak fifth-up from the inside barrier. Snagged back early and circled the field with the 60kg for a fast finishing second over 2400m at Rosehill in this grade. Can race a touch closer with Grima's claim. No excuses today. GOLDEN CENTURY (2) win record hardly excites but indicated he was near his top with a narrow third over this trip at Rosehill. Gets the gun run with J Mac aboard. Top-three contender. LE TROISIR (5) covered plenty of ground in the run and sprinted quickly in the straight with a tough win over 2400m at Rosehill. Can handle the weight rise and play a leading role again. I PARK (7) dropped in class when he bounced back with a gritty on-pace third over 1900m at Canterbury in BM72 grade. Deserves another chance out to the 2400m. TRAPALANDA (6) ready for this trip fourth-up and desperate for the firmer surface. Capable of taking a hand in the finish.
